name: Illuminor Szeras
oracle_text: Secrets of the Soul — {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Add an amount of {B} equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value.
blocked_sentences: Secrets of the Soul — {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Add an amount of {B} equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value.

needs.what: a mana ability whose add_mana amount reads the object its own sacrifice cost paid with, i.e. cost {"tap": true, "sacrifice": {"types": ["Creature"], "exclude_self": true, "as": "sacrificed"}} with add_mana {"mana": "{B}", "amount": {"mana_value_of": {"binding": "sacrificed"}}}. That means passing the cost's bindings from pay() into mana_amount on Game._activate_mana, and having the payment solver either skip such sources or price each sacrifice choice as its own option
needs.why_existing_wont_do: sacrifice's `as` binding plus mana_value_of works only on abilities that use the stack (Broadside Bombardiers, Dina, Ghoulcaller Gisa). On the mana-ability path, Game._activate_mana calls costs.pay without a bindings dict, and costs.mana_amount builds a fresh EffectContext with no bindings, so the amount cannot see the sacrificed creature. Writing the line as a non-mana activated ability would put mana on the stack, which breaks 605.1a. add_mana_per and the board-reading amounts count permanents rather than the paid object
